The highest-purity public fuel-cycle name is Centrus Energy for HALEU/enrichment. BWX Technologies maps to nuclear-grade components, fuel, and defense/commercial nuclear manufacturing. Fluor is a second-order EPC/execution candidate via its NuScale ownership and nuclear engineering role. NuScale is included as a reference product/licensing leader, but should be treated separately from fuel-cycle and execution bottleneck beneficiaries because reactor-developer attention can crowd out more obscure suppliers. Cameco/Westinghouse is a major reference fuel-cycle anchor but excluded from the 4-candidate limit to preserve underfollowed lane capacity. Expanded the US-listed universe around the regulated nuclear fuel and reactor supply-chain node, with emphasis on scarce HALEU enrichment, TRISO/advanced-fuel fabrication, qualified nuclear components, and EPC-adjacent execution rather than utilities alone. The strongest chokepoint exposure appears in Centrus Energy for HALEU enrichment and BWX Technologies for qualified nuclear components, advanced fuel, and reactor manufacturing. X-energy adds a public-market pure-play around advanced reactors plus TRISO-X fuel fabrication licensing, while ASP Isotopes is a speculative shadow candidate tied to future isotope/enrichment capacity but still requiring major regulatory and technical validation.
